name: Instant Charge (Red IC)
summary: IC Nayuki's {input:5C}, then catch its pushback with sliding {input:2C}.
description: IC Nayuki's {input:5C}, then catch its pushback with sliding {input:2C}.

pages.title: Instant Charge
pages.text: While your RF Gauge is {tone:red_ic|Red}, input {input:22C} the moment an attack connects to perform {tone:red_ic|Red IC}. IC spends the gauge, cuts the attack's recovery short, and briefly freezes the screen. Only attacks that allow IC can use it.

pages.title: The Drill
pages.text: Normally Nayuki's {input:5C} can't cancel into {input:2C} at all. IC changes that - and her sliding 2C reaches right across the pushback: {input:5C} > {input:22C} > {input:2C}.

tasks.label: Perform {input:5C} > {input:22C} > {input:2C} on hit at Red RF
tasks.prompt: Land 5C, IC it, then slide in with 2C before the combo drops.

feedback.success: Nice - IC erased 5C's recovery and sliding 2C caught the pushback.
feedback.failure: Make sure 5C connects, hit 22C during its IC window, then go straight into 2C.
